library.pt_360:r_415fd0ec76af8ca3.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$'s younger sister, and 87th in line for the Britannian throne. 15 years old.
She was present when their mother Marianne was assassinated and was caught in the crossfire, losing the sight of both eyes and the use of both legs.
She was the very reason $$ルルーシュ$$ fought, but after the Black Rebellion her whereabouts became unknown.
After Zero's return, however, she appeared before $$ルルーシュ$$ again as an imperial princess of Britannia and the new Viceroy of $$エリア１１$$.
Once installed as Viceroy, she held to the conviction that the world could be changed for the gentler, and kept searching for a way for people of different races and values to walk the same path together.
During the Second Battle of Tokyo she was swallowed by the Freya's explosion and went missing, only to reappear as Schneizel's puppet empress, standing in $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s way.
At the final battle she resolved to take the sin upon herself and grasped the control switch for the Freya warhead. Her strong will broke through even the $$ギアス$$ that had rewritten her father Charles's memory.
Afterward, moments before her execution as a traitor, she witnessed the Zero Requiem unfold before her eyes. Understanding her brother's true intent at last, $$ナナリー$$ clung to his body and wept as the crowd's voices rose in praise of Zero, the hero who had struck down the evil $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

library.pt_360:r_533fe30fc5f189fe.text:
One of the Knights of the Round, the strongest knights of the Empire -- Knight of Three. 17 years old.
Though born into an illustrious noble family, he earned the rank of Knight of Three on his own merit.
He is cheerful, easygoing, and looks out for others. After his transfer to $$エリア１１$$ he showed off his boundless curiosity by transferring into $$アッシュフォード学園$$ alongside $$アーニャ$$.
He took a strong interest in $$カレン$$ after meeting her on the battlefield, and when she was taken prisoner he invited her to take a Britannian name.
When $$ルルーシュ$$ eventually became Emperor of Britannia and $$スザク$$ became his knight, $$ジノ$$ turned against them. He briefly lost sight of why he fought, but resolved to fight $$ルルーシュ$$ and took part in the final battle.
There, wielding the Tristan Divider equipped with the Excalibur that Bismarck had left behind, he let $$ルルーシュ$$ escape but destroyed his mount, the $$蜃気楼$$.

library.pt_360:r_3e3afc827b8b97cb.text:
One of the Knights of the Round, the strongest knights of the Empire -- Knight of Six. 15 years old.
A formidable talent who rose to the rank of Rounds Knight at the youngest age on record. She rarely shows emotion and behaves with a detached calm, though on rare occasions she does things that defy common sense.
She always carries a cell phone and photographs everything she calls a 'memory,' but this was in fact a way of filling in the memories she lost each time Marianne -- $$ルルーシュ$$'s mother, who had entered her mind through a $$ギアス$$ that transfers others' consciousness -- awakened within her. These lost memories never returned even after Marianne was erased.
At the final battle she fought $$ジェレミア$$ as part of Schneizel's forces and destroyed his Sutherland Sieg, but was defeated by the self-destruct attack of the Sutherland J that emerged from within it. From their exchange, $$ジェレミア$$ realized some kind of $$ギアス$$ had been placed on $$アーニャ$$, and his $$ギアス$$ Canceller freed her completely from Marianne.
After the final battle, she was seen at $$ジェレミア$$'s side, working at the orange farm.

library.pt_360:r_b8f42059c6b83a56.text:
Leader of the '$$扇$$ Group,' a resistance organization that once operated around the Tokyo Settlement, and vice commander of the Black Knights. 27 years old.
He sheltered the amnesiac Villetta Nu, naming her Chigusa and caring for her, and in doing so came to hold special feelings for her. Those feelings did not fade even after Villetta, having regained her memory during the Black Rebellion, shot him.
After the Black Rebellion he was held by Britannia for over a year, but was rescued along with the other Black Knights members by the returned Zero. He served once more as vice commander of the Black Knights under Zero, and as Secretary-General of the United Federation of Nations forces.
Even during their long separation $$扇$$'s feelings for Villetta never disappeared, and when she told him the truth about Zero's identity and his $$ギアス$$, $$扇$$ realized that to Zero they were nothing more than pawns, and chose to part ways with him.
After the Zero Requiem, he married Villetta and became Prime Minister of a Japan independent from Britannia.

library.pt_360:r_c382396a06acaefd.text:
An engineer from the Chinese Federation's Indian Military District. 29 years old.
She once studied abroad in Britannia, where she was a contemporary of Lloyd and Cecile, but she dislikes Lloyd and calls him 'Earl Pudding.' According to Cecile, though, the reason the two of them are always at each other's throats seems to be something rather trivial.
She developed Black Knights KMFs such as the Guren Type-02 and the Gekka, but after the Black Rebellion she went into hiding in the Chinese Federation along with Diethard and the others. When she learned that Zero had returned, she rejoined the Black Knights.
Afterward she deployed the Guren Kashoshiki, Zangetsu, and Akatsuki in succession, and served as Minister of Science within the United Federation of Nations forces.

library.pt_360:r_35b1467008e1d36e.text:
A maid dispatched by the Ashford family to look after $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$ナナリー$$, and an Honorary Britannian. 25 years old.
In truth she is the 37th head of the Shinozaki School of bodyguards, and secretly a member of the Black Knights.
After the Black Rebellion she went into hiding in the Chinese Federation with Diethard and the others, but on learning of Zero's return she rejoined the Black Knights. From then on she mainly worked as $$ルルーシュ$$'s body double, though her natural airheadedness often threw situations into confusion.
At the Second Battle of Tokyo she infiltrated the government headquarters to seize $$ナナリー$$, now Viceroy. She succeeded in rescuing the captive $$カレン$$, but failed to recapture $$ナナリー$$.
Afterward she went missing for a long time, but eventually rushed to $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s side and continued to support him to the very end. $$ジェレミア$$, in a similar position himself, called her devotion in following the master she had chosen, $$ルルーシュ$$, despite being Japanese, a form of chivalry.

library.pt_360:r_b358323930128b43.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
He has the Element ability 'Gravity Interference,' which lets him float into the air when emotionally excited. But he hates this power, since it caused others to shun him and led to his mother abandoning him, so he hid it away and worked as a live-in employee at a movie theater.
He loves the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' and fell in love at first sight with $$ミコノ$$ after seeing her moved to tears by it.
He is a somewhat faint-hearted boy who is easily flustered, but when it truly matters he has the inner strength to overcome his fear and fight.
From the moment he used his hidden power to save $$ミコノ$$ from an Abductor attack, he was drawn into a fateful struggle.

library.pt_360:r_b802e3d088f8aab4.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
He has the Element ability 'Gravity Interference,' which lets him float into the air when emotionally excited. But he hates this power, since it caused others to shun him and led to his mother abandoning him, so he hid it away and worked as a live-in employee at a movie theater.
He loves the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' and fell in love at first sight with $$ミコノ$$ after seeing her moved to tears by it.
He is a somewhat faint-hearted boy who is easily flustered, but when it truly matters he has the inner strength to overcome his fear and fight.
He used his hidden power to save $$ミコノ$$ from an Abductor attack, and that act also awakened Aquarion EVOL. Taking this as his chance, he enrolled at Holy Angel Academy as an Element cadet, and from then on found himself locked in an ongoing struggle against the Abductors.
He is the reincarnation of $$アポロン$$, who fought the $$堕天翅$$ with the Mythical Aquarion 12,000 years ago, and $$カグラ$$, who shares half of that same divided soul, repeatedly clashed with him over $$ミコノ$$.
But unlike $$カグラ$$, who saw $$ミコノ$$ only as the reincarnation of Sylvia, $$アマタ$$ loved $$ミコノ$$ for who she was in the present, regardless of the past, and kept fighting to protect her.
When $$ミコノ$$ was captured by $$ミカゲ$$, who was consumed by hatred from the past, $$アマタ$$ fought the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$ alongside his comrades. Facing its overwhelming power, he was on the verge of defeat, but driven by his single desire to save $$ミコノ$$, he charged in alone aboard Vector Zed. His powerful feelings won out, and he succeeded in rescuing $$ミコノ$$. Together they combined into Aquarion LOVE, putting an end to a myth 24,000 years in the making.

library.pt_360:r_bcd1fe0bad1a9e1c.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
She met $$アマタ$$ at the movie theater where she went to see the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$.'
She is normally cheerful and gentle, but having grown up constantly compared to her excellent older brother $$カイエン$$ by their parents, she has trouble feeling confident in herself.
She is a hard worker, but clumsy and unable to take that last decisive step. Because her personality is so similar to $$アマタ$$'s, the two sometimes call each other 'fellow no-hopers.'
She has no special Element ability of her own, which has become a source of insecurity for her.

library.pt_360:r_d90e04261cd2be4d.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
She met $$アマタ$$ at the movie theater where she went to see the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$.'
She is normally cheerful and gentle, but having grown up constantly compared to her excellent older brother $$カイエン$$ by their parents, she has trouble feeling confident in herself.
She is a hard worker, but clumsy and unable to take that last decisive step. Because her personality is so similar to $$アマタ$$'s, the two sometimes call each other 'fellow no-hopers.'
She has no special Element ability of her own, and that had long been a source of insecurity for her. In truth, though, her ability was a special one that no instrument could measure -- 'the Power to Connect,' a type of ability that let her share and amplify the abilities and senses of other Elements.
She is the reincarnation of Sylvia from 12,000 years ago, and found herself caught between the feelings of $$アマタ$$ and $$カグラ$$, both reincarnations of $$アポロン$$, tormented by memories reaching back into the past.
While held captive within $$ミカゲ$$'s labyrinth of the heart, she learned the depth of $$ミカゲ$$'s feelings for Apollonius and tried to accept his sorrow, but was rejected by him.
Together with $$アマタ$$, who charged in alone to save her from $$ミカゲ$$'s grasp, their love completed Aquarion LOVE and saved the world.

library.pt_360:r_af91159a3e472c8d.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An energetic girl, bold even with the opposite sex, who likes to wear revealing clothes.
She boasts the highest combat ability among the female cadets and often gets to pilot Aquarion. She excels at hand-to-hand combat and is someone the team can rely on in battle, though she also has a girlish side, such as being afraid of ghosts.
Her Element ability is 'Impact Force,' which lets her amplify a small amount of force into a much greater one.
She often teases $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, both hopelessly shy, about their relationship.

library.pt_360:r_6ba3434be2d42670.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An energetic girl, bold even with the opposite sex, who likes to wear revealing clothes.
She boasts the highest combat ability among the female cadets and often gets to pilot Aquarion. She excels at hand-to-hand combat and is someone the team can rely on in battle, though she also has a girlish side, such as being afraid of ghosts.
Her Element ability is 'Impact Force,' which lets her amplify a small amount of force into a much greater one.
She often teased $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, both hopelessly shy, about their relationship, but gradually began to see $$アマタ$$ as more than a friend herself.
Unable to break into the one-sided devotion $$アマタ$$ held for $$ミコノ$$, she came to despise herself for never being able to make a move. Out of that frustration, she awakened a new Element ability, 'Twisting Force,' which lets her twist and deform objects.
During a mock battle involving $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$, she confessed her feelings on impulse, and the resulting rush of emotion sent Aquarion out of control.
Afterward she continued to suffer from the pain of $$アマタ$$ never returning her feelings, and eventually $$ミカゲ$$ exploited that opening in her heart and took over her body.
However, after breaking free of $$ミカゲ$$'s control together with $$カグラ$$, she let go of everything and lent her support to $$アマタ$$ as he fought to save $$ミコノ$$.

library.pt_360:r_c6b50f4cc1b5d065.text:
The form $$ミカゲ$$ takes when possessing $$ゼシカ$$, tormented by her unrequited love for $$アマタ$$.
Outwardly nothing about her appears to change, but her spirit is trapped within $$ミカゲ$$'s labyrinth of the heart, and her hair changes color when her true nature surfaces.
Disguised as $$ゼシカ$$, she lures $$カグラ$$, who carries the soul of $$アポロン$$, with the idea that he alone could operate the Mythical-type Aquarion, and gets him to activate it together with $$ミコノ$$.

library.pt_360:r_16dcd33b53e1300c.text:
The form $$ミカゲ$$ takes when possessing $$ゼシカ$$, tormented by her unrequited love for $$アマタ$$.
Outwardly nothing about her appears to change, but her spirit is trapped within $$ミカゲ$$'s labyrinth of the heart, and her hair changes color when her true nature surfaces.
Disguised as $$ゼシカ$$, she lures $$カグラ$$, who carries the soul of $$アポロン$$, with the idea that he alone could operate the Mythical-type Aquarion, and gets him to activate it together with $$ミコノ$$, then absorbs the power of Altair's star, giving birth to the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$.
Her spirit, trapped within $$ミカゲ$$'s labyrinth of the heart, suffered at the thought of trying to kill $$アマタ$$ and the others, and she begged $$カグラ$$, who was likewise trapped through their forced combination, to kill her, but he refused. $$カグラ$$ rescued her instead, and the two of them sought to escape together.

library.pt_360:r_fe80df2508b970e8.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
The de facto leader among the Element cadets, a man known as the 'Eternal Number Two.'
A former marine, he comes from a military family that has produced Element-abled soldiers for generations. His good build, wild manner, and strictness toward himself and others alike make him dependable, and he is popular with the girls.
He is also $$ミコノ$$'s older brother by blood. He is hard on her, but in truth he worries about her and only pushes her away from the fighting out of concern for her safety. Because of this, he has no great fondness for $$アマタ$$, who was the reason $$ミコノ$$ became an Element cadet in the first place.
His Element ability is 'Despair Precognition.' It manifests regardless of his own will, letting him foresee misfortunes that will befall him.
Because of $$シュレード$$'s presence, he is derided as the 'Eternal Number Two,' but since $$シュレード$$ is often unable to sortie, $$カイエン$$ is effectively Neo-DEAVA's main fighting strength. He is uncomfortable with being called $$シュレード$$'s 'best friend.'

library.pt_360:r_f9c7483f4f13a2d7.text:

He is uncomfortable with being called $$シュレード$$'s 'best friend,' but deep down he feels just as strong a bond with him.
At the final battle, he boarded the Vector Siron carrying $$シュレード$$'s feelings within it, and brought forth a new configuration, Aquarion Geparda.

library.pt_360:r_03fe4bdae2f6dc29.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An optimist and Neo-DEAVA's mood-maker. He became an Element cadet in hopes of one day combining with his destined woman, and is aggressive about making an impression on girls.
He has the ability 'Digging Force,' which lets him find the weak points in a material's bonds and break through them to dig holes.
In search of that destined woman, he keeps relentlessly digging in an attempt to cross the 'Berlin Wall' separating the boys' and girls' sections of Holy Angel Academy. His obsession runs deep, and he even formed the 'Digging Brothers' with the newly transferred $$アマタ$$ to share the joys of digging with him.
He is on terrible terms with $$ＭＩＸ$$, who is a germaphobe, hates men, and despises the very existence of holes.

library.pt_360:r_a1ce0344e069baea.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An optimist and Neo-DEAVA's mood-maker. He became an Element cadet in hopes of one day combining with his destined woman, and is aggressive about making an impression on girls.
He has the ability 'Digging Force,' which lets him find the weak points in a material's bonds and break through them to dig holes.
In search of that destined woman, he keeps relentlessly digging in an attempt to cross the 'Berlin Wall' separating the boys' and girls' sections of Holy Angel Academy. His obsession runs deep, and he even formed the 'Digging Brothers' with the newly transferred $$アマタ$$ to share the joys of digging with him.
He was on terrible terms with $$ＭＩＸ$$, who is a germaphobe, hates men, and despises the very existence of holes, but as they complemented each other's abilities through battle, they gradually became important to one another.
When $$ＭＩＸ$$ was captured by Altair and her body was turned male, he struggled to come to terms with it. But he resolved to accept her (him?) regardless of gender, confessed his feelings, and succeeded in rescuing her safely.

library.pt_360:r_cebbb328e750d03c.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
A beautiful boy who is a genius pianist and, with combat ability to match, boasts skill among the very best of the Element cadets.
However, he is sickly, and each time he resonates with Aquarion his life is shortened, so he can rarely take part in actual combat.
He likens every battle to a piece of music, treating the fight itself as a single composition, and his goal is to complete the ultimate melody, even at the cost of his own life.
His Element ability is 'Mental Performance,' which lets him play music to confuse the hearts of others. This ability was exploited in his childhood, but he was scouted by $$クレア$$ and became an Element cadet.
He calls $$カイエン$$ his 'best friend,' though the feeling is one-sided.

library.pt_360:r_692812ecd1f95aac.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
A beautiful boy who is a genius pianist and, with combat ability to match, boasts skill among the very best of the Element cadets.
However, he is sickly, and each time he resonates with Aquarion his life is shortened, so he can rarely take part in actual combat.
He likens every battle to a piece of music, treating the fight itself as a single composition, and his goal is to complete the ultimate melody, even at the cost of his own life.
His Element ability is 'Mental Performance,' which lets him play music to confuse the hearts of others. This ability was exploited in his childhood, but he was scouted by $$クレア$$ and became an Element cadet.
He calls $$カイエン$$ his 'best friend,' though he believes the feeling is one-sided; in truth, $$カイエン$$ feels just as strong a bond with him.
As the fighting intensified, his sorties increased and his body was steadily worn away. He used up the last of his strength to help $$アマタ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ cross the dimensional barrier, and vanished beyond the dimensional horizon along with his Vector Machine. Yet at the very brink of death, his ultimate melody was completed, and at the final battle, $$カイエン$$, riding the Vector Siron infused with the melody of his soul, brought forth a new configuration, Aquarion Geparda.

library.pt_360:r_43715ccf90e1f215.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
In contrast to his ethnic-styled looks, he is serious and level-headed, and among a roster of highly individualistic cadets he serves as both peacemaker and voice of reason.
He is well trusted, to the point that classmates say, 'If $$モロイ$$ says so, it must be right!'
His Element ability is 'Fragility Force,' which breaks down the molecular bonds of any material, making it easy to shatter with even a slight impact. Combined with a physical attack, this lets him deal a great deal of damage.

library.pt_360:r_560d6e6f0dc2a4e6.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
In contrast to his ethnic-styled looks, he is serious and level-headed, and among a roster of highly individualistic cadets he serves as both peacemaker and voice of reason.
He is well trusted, to the point that classmates say, 'If $$モロイ$$ says so, it must be right!'
His Element ability is 'Fragility Force,' which breaks down the molecular bonds of any material, making it easy to shatter with even a slight impact. Combined with a physical attack, this lets him deal a great deal of damage.
In a mock battle, he combined his ability with $$サザンカ$$'s 'Corrosion Force' to drive $$アマタ$$ and the others into a corner.
At the final battle, claiming that being born in the tropics made him tough against the heat, he sortied undaunted by the black sun $$ミカゲ$$ had summoned.

library.pt_360:r_b8bd6ed8d5ceb43f.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An excellent student and a caring student-council-president type of girl.
She has an outstanding figure that $$アンディ$$ has dubbed the 'Big Bang.'
A perfectionist and germaphobe, she is strict with herself and others, and tolerates neither breaches of discipline nor romance between students.
In the past, her father vanished with a younger woman to a secluded hot spring, and growing up watching her mother's struggles left her with a trauma that made her hate men and holes alike.
Her Element ability is 'Spatial Compensation,' which lets her seal off space at the molecular level without leaving the slightest gap.
She has clashed with $$アンディ$$, whose ability 'Digging Force' is her exact opposite, time and again, their Element abilities colliding head-on.

library.pt_360:r_1eb9e1c045f8019e.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
An excellent student and a caring student-council-president type of girl.
She has an outstanding figure that $$アンディ$$ has dubbed the 'Big Bang.'
A perfectionist and germaphobe, she is strict with herself and others, and tolerates neither breaches of discipline nor romance between students.
In the past, her father vanished with a younger woman to a secluded hot spring, and growing up watching her mother's struggles left her with a trauma that made her hate men and holes alike.
Her Element ability is 'Spatial Compensation,' which lets her seal off space at the molecular level without leaving the slightest gap.
She has clashed with $$アンディ$$, whose ability 'Digging Force' is her exact opposite, time and again, their Element abilities colliding head-on.
On learning that Altair's aim was to abduct women with Element abilities, she let herself be captured in order to save $$ゼシカ$$, who, driven to despair by heartbreak, was about to surrender herself.
Afterward, under the influence of the 'Curse of Eve,' her body was turned male. With her memories manipulated, she was made to fight Neo-DEAVA as a boy soldier.
In the end, $$アンディ$$'s desperate persuasion brought her memories back, and she accepted his love. Having returned to Vega, her body seems to be gradually reverting as well.

library.pt_360:r_f9c83b578b73d701.text:
A soldier of Altair.
The form $$ＭＩＸ$$ took after being abducted by Altair, her body turned male under the influence of the 'Curse of Eve.'
Her memories have been manipulated, erasing all recollection of her past.

library.pt_360:r_e2a8754d971dd87a.text:
A soldier of Altair.
The form $$ＭＩＸ$$ took after being abducted by Altair, her body turned male under the influence of the 'Curse of Eve.'
Her memories have been manipulated, erasing all recollection of her past.
But through $$アンディ$$'s repeated calls to her, she eventually regained her memories and returned safely to Neo-DEAVA together with him.

library.pt_360:r_d5cc3c7d73eeafed.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
Extremely shy and awkward around strangers.
She always carries around Tama, a stuffed toy that may or may not be a cat.
When she first transferred in, she could not fit in with her class, and her wish to simply disappear triggered her Element ability, 'Optical Transparency.' This ability lets her turn objects, herself included, invisible, and when piloting Aquarion it renders the entire unit invisible, letting laser weapons pass right through it.
Because this power made her vanish whenever she appeared in front of others, and her body stayed invisible for long stretches of time, she became the subject of a ghost story known as 'the Vanishing Element.'
However, meeting the other cadets has slowly begun to bring her out of her shell.

library.pt_360:r_3727b9f1fd4829c6.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
Extremely shy and awkward around strangers.
She always carries around Tama, a stuffed toy that may or may not be a cat.
When she first transferred in, she could not fit in with her class, and her wish to simply disappear triggered her Element ability, 'Optical Transparency.' This ability lets her turn objects, herself included, invisible, and when piloting Aquarion it renders the entire unit invisible, letting laser weapons pass right through it.
Because this power made her vanish whenever she appeared in front of others, and her body stayed invisible for long stretches of time, she became the subject of a ghost story known as 'the Vanishing Element.'
However, meeting the other cadets slowly began to bring her out of her shell.
When $$ジン$$ infiltrated Neo-DEAVA disguised as a transfer student, she worried about him and looked out for him, since he made no effort to fit in with the other cadets. When $$ジン$$ tried to steal a Vector Machine, she talked him out of it, and the two of them came to understand each other, only for $$ミカゲ$$ to take $$ジン$$'s life shortly after.
She sank into grief for a time, but returned to duty after hearing $$ジン$$'s voice during grueling training undertaken in his memory. Overcoming the sorrow of losing someone precious to her, she grew both gentler and stronger.

library.pt_360:r_5a4171d19193f3cf.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
A cheerful girl who loves to fantasize. She adores beautiful boys combining together, and often gets a nosebleed daydreaming about pairing up $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$. Her catchphrase is 'I'm gonna rot away!'
She also enjoys candid photography as a hobby, and has a formidable business sense for turning a profit by selling the photos she takes.
Her Element ability is 'Corrosion Force,' which lets her rot and decay any material.

library.pt_360:r_943a572284505262.text:
An Element cadet at Neo-DEAVA.
A cheerful girl who loves to fantasize. She adores beautiful boys combining together, and often gets a nosebleed daydreaming about pairing up $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$. Her catchphrase is 'I'm gonna rot away!'
She also enjoys candid photography as a hobby, and has a formidable business sense for turning a profit by selling the photos she takes.
Her Element ability is 'Corrosion Force,' which lets her rot and decay any material.
In a mock battle, she teamed up with $$カイエン$$ and $$モロイ$$ to corrode EVOL's legs and leave it unable to move.

library.pt_360:r_0620b90057656baf.text:
Commander of Neo-DEAVA and chairwoman of Holy Angel Academy.
A mysterious, beautiful girl who is always together with $$不動$$.
She traveled the world in search of Aquarion, but upon hearing news of its revival she returned and resumed her post as commander.
Though she looks like nothing more than a girl, her IQ is said to exceed 300, and her true age is unknown. She speaks to the Element cadets with an adult's manner of speech.
Yet she also has a girlish side, being extremely fond of donuts, which are always kept on her desk in the command room.

library.pt_360:r_f80945ac44536638.text:
Commander of Neo-DEAVA and chairwoman of Holy Angel Academy.
A mysterious, beautiful girl who is always together with $$不動$$.
She traveled the world in search of Aquarion, but upon hearing news of its revival she returned and resumed her post as commander.
Though she looks like nothing more than a girl, her IQ is said to exceed 300, and her true age is unknown. She speaks to the Element cadets with an adult's manner of speech.
Yet she also has a girlish side, being extremely fond of donuts, which are always kept on her desk in the command room.
She possesses the Element ability 'Teleport,' and at the final battle, after the death of $$シュレード$$, whom she had cared deeply about, she boarded a Vector Machine herself. Together with $$カイエン$$ and the others, she boarded Aquarion Geparda and fought $$ミカゲ$$.

library.pt_360:r_ef0ce0a06285b97a.text:
An Abductor pilot.
Belligerent by nature, he pilots the $$ミスラ・グニス$$ and fights with the same raw ferocity as his temperament. He also has a keen sense of smell, and everything about his behavior is wild. His words carry the opposite meaning under a certain rule, leaving listeners confused.
He repeatedly went after $$ミコノ$$, calling her 'my own damn woman,' and clashed fiercely with $$アマタ$$ each time.

library.pt_360:r_743937f485312ac4.text:
A pilot of Altair.
Belligerent by nature, he pilots the $$ミスラ・グニス$$ and fights with the same raw ferocity as his temperament. He also has a keen sense of smell, and everything about his behavior is wild.
He repeatedly went after $$ミコノ$$, calling her 'my own damn woman,' and clashed fiercely with $$アマタ$$ each time.
His true identity is another $$アマタ$$: when their mother $$アリシア$$ departed for Altair, the boy who merely watched her go and the boy who chased after her split into two beings in body and soul, becoming $$アマタ$$ and $$カグラ$$. After crossing over to Altair he lost his memories, and was taken in and raised by $$ミカゲ$$, whose twisted love led him to place his faith in nothing but his own power.
Through the fighting, guided by $$ミカゲ$$, he awakened the Element ability 'Reversal Force,' which reverses any phenomenon or force. This same ability is also the reason his words come out reversed from what he means to say, under a certain rule.
Like $$アマタ$$, $$カグラ$$ too is a reincarnation of $$アポロン$$, and for that reason he found himself strongly drawn to $$ミコノ$$, the reincarnation of Sylvia.
At the final battle, he acknowledged that $$アマタ$$ loved $$ミコノ$$ regardless of memories from a past life, and lent his support to $$アマタ$$ as he challenged $$ミカゲ$$, the source of it all.

library.pt_360:r_d8437fbeced2b873.text:
A boy called Altair's last child.
Unlike $$カグラ$$, he is a cerebral type skilled at electronic warfare, and pilots the $$ラディウス・グニス$$.
He runs endless simulations of past combat data and enters battle prepared for every contingency. His thoroughly calculated tactics drove Neo-DEAVA into a corner more than once.
However, his pride is also a weakness, leaving him poorly equipped to respond to the unexpected.
He has no interest in flesh-and-blood women, and instead is in love with a female virtual idol.

library.pt_360:r_b1dbc7946faac5e3.text:
A boy called Altair's last child.
Unlike $$カグラ$$, he is a cerebral type skilled at electronic warfare, and pilots the $$ラディウス・グニス$$.
He runs endless simulations of past combat data and enters battle prepared for every contingency. His thoroughly calculated tactics drove Neo-DEAVA into a corner more than once.
However, his pride is also a weakness, leaving him poorly equipped to respond to the unexpected.
He has no interest in flesh-and-blood women, and instead is in love with a female virtual idol.
Ordered by $$イズモ$$ to search for Aquarion and the $$レア・イグラー$$, he enrolled at Holy Angel Academy under a false identity.
At first he could not adjust to life surrounded by girls, but through talking with $$ユノハ$$, who was just as shy as he was, he gradually opened up to her. When $$カグラ$$ attacked Neo-DEAVA, he took the opportunity to steal a Vector Machine along with $$ユノハ$$ and try to return to Altair. But $$ユノハ$$'s persuasion made him honest with his own feelings, and he boarded Aquarion as one of the Elements and fought $$カグラ$$.
The other members came to accept him as a new comrade, but immediately afterward his life was taken by a thought-form of $$ミカゲ$$.

library.pt_360:r_ee9b9d4c183df0c8.text:
A mysterious creature that stays with $$ミコノ$$.
$$ミコノ$$ calls it a 'cat,' though $$アマタ$$ has his doubts.
Normally it takes the shape of a ribbon-like ornament in $$ミコノ$$'s hair or on her shoulder, but it reacts in various ways depending on $$ミコノ$$'s emotions.
It has a jealous streak, and tends to threaten or bite people $$ミコノ$$ is especially close to, such as $$アマタ$$ and $$ユノハ$$.

library.pt_360:r_4590347d80145935.text:
Supreme Commander of Neo-DEAVA.
He was initially disguised as a school custodian and the like, but returned openly when Aquarion EVOL revived.
He always carries himself as though he sees through everything, giving $$クレア$$ and the Element cadets cryptic, Zen-koan-like advice that leaves them baffled. But it always carries a deep purpose, and understanding its meaning can lead one out of even the direst situation.
When he uses analogies, he tends to reach for donuts.

library.pt_360:r_d72518880a7a0e9f.text:
Supreme Commander of Neo-DEAVA.
He was initially disguised as a school custodian and the like, but returned openly when Aquarion EVOL revived.
He always carries himself as though he sees through everything, giving $$クレア$$ and the Element cadets cryptic, Zen-koan-like advice that leaves them baffled. But it always carries a deep purpose, and understanding its meaning can lead one out of even the direst situation.
When he uses analogies, he tends to reach for donuts.
He guided $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, the reincarnations of the Elements who fought 12,000 years ago, and once the battle was settled, he took $$ミカゲ$$'s soul, left with nowhere to go as pure resentment, into his own heart and sealed it away.

library.pt_360:r_255a1f93304baa2b.text:
Commander of Neo-DEAVA and principal of Holy Angel Academy.
He dresses like a military officer, and was one of the few people who knew that 'Aquarion' was the true name behind 'Aquaria.' Since $$不動$$ and $$クレア$$'s return, he has given up his seat to $$クレア$$ and now serves under her.

library.pt_360:r_b882e8ff236c0405.text:
Deputy Commander of Neo-DEAVA and a teacher at Holy Angel Academy.
He is in charge of educating the male students, including combat training.
Belligerent by nature, he prioritizes the annihilation of the enemy above all else, and brings a harsh, military-style Spartan discipline to his classes and training.
The forearm of his attachment-type prosthetic arm can be fitted with interchangeable attachments such as a stun gun or a fork.

library.pt_360:r_0cd886646cad75e3.text:
Deputy Commander of Neo-DEAVA and a teacher at Holy Angel Academy.
He is in charge of educating the male students, including combat training.
Belligerent by nature, he prioritizes the annihilation of the enemy above all else, and brings a harsh, military-style Spartan discipline to his classes and training.
The forearm of his attachment-type prosthetic arm can be fitted with interchangeable attachments such as a stun gun or a fork.
Nine years ago, he was an Element cadet who piloted Aquarion himself. But when his romantic feelings for his girlfriend Nanaon reached a peak, Aquarion ran out of control, and he lost both his girlfriend and his own arms. From then on, male-female combination in Aquarion was forbidden.
He and his colleague $$スオミ$$ have clashed a number of times over differences in teaching philosophy, but at the final battle, when Chairwoman $$クレア$$ told her, 'If it comes to it, become the next Adam and Eve,' and $$スオミ$$ agreed, he was visibly shaken.

library.pt_360:r_69647a08269facf1.text:
Deputy Commander of Neo-DEAVA and a teacher at Holy Angel Academy.
Before the fall of the Berlin Wall, she taught on the girls' side.
Her personality is straitlaced to the point of rigidity, so she does not much approve of male-female combination and tends to look down on men somewhat.
Since she took up her post later than $$ドナール$$ or the Commander, she knew almost nothing of the truth behind Aquarion.
As fellow deputy commanders, she and $$ドナール$$ spend a great deal of time together, but their opposing ways of thinking often put them at odds.

library.pt_360:r_57a3c314c777890d.text:
Deputy Commander of Neo-DEAVA and a teacher at Holy Angel Academy.
Before the fall of the Berlin Wall, she taught on the girls' side.
Her personality is straitlaced to the point of rigidity, so she does not much approve of male-female combination and tends to look down on men somewhat.
Since she took up her post later than $$ドナール$$ or the Commander, she knew almost nothing of the truth behind Aquarion.
As fellow deputy commanders, she and $$ドナール$$ spend a great deal of time together, but their opposing ways of thinking often put them at odds.
But her feelings changed as the fighting continued, and she gradually began to see $$ドナール$$ differently.
Before the final battle, when $$クレア$$, about to sortie, told her that if it came to it she should become the next era's Adam with $$ドナール$$ as her Eve, she agreed.

library.pt_360:r_87d91fa4fe21d113.text:
A priest of Altair.
He can use a wide range of psychic abilities.
Deeply mysterious, his capricious words and actions sometimes lend aid and sometimes cause obstruction, leaving even Supreme Commander $$イズモ$$ at his mercy.
He found $$カグラ$$ as a child in the slums and raised him.
He had been asleep for many years, but awoke in response to Aquarion's revival and began to act toward his own private ends.

library.pt_360:r_eccd5eb89662c09d.text:
A priest of Altair.
He can use a wide range of psychic abilities.
Deeply mysterious, his capricious words and actions sometimes lend aid and sometimes cause obstruction, leaving even Supreme Commander $$イズモ$$ at his mercy.
He found $$カグラ$$ as a child in the slums and raised him.
He had been asleep for many years, but awoke in response to Aquarion's revival and began to act toward his own private ends.
His true identity is the dark portion of $$頭翅$$, born when $$頭翅$$ learned that he was not, in fact, the reincarnation of Apollonius, whom $$アポロン$$ loved. $$頭翅$$ himself accepted this truth and became a living sacrifice to save the world, but the part of his heart that could not accept it ran wild and took on a form of its own.
He sought to revive the Mythical-type Aquarion and use its power to destroy both Vega and Altair, in order to create a new world.
At the final battle, he seized the Mythical-type and absorbed the whole of Altair's energy. He then conjured a black sun to try to scorch the Earth dry, transformed the Mythical-type Aquarion into the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$, and stood in $$アマタ$$'s way. But he was defeated before $$アマタ$$, who sought to save $$ミコノ$$ beyond the bounds of fate, and Neo-DEAVA, who lent $$アマタ$$ their support.
Afterward, he was taken in by $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ and fell asleep within his heart.

library.pt_360:r_fd29023c9f0f620d.text:
Supreme Commander of Altair.
A hero who has developed Altair using the Iron-C technology developed by his mother, Oriza Kamuroki. He commands the effort to restore his home planet, which stands on the brink of ruin.
Deep down, he distrusts $$ミカゲ$$, whose true intentions he cannot read.

library.pt_360:r_9550e2cda9c557d5.text:
Supreme Commander of Altair.
A hero who has developed Altair using the Iron-C technology developed by his mother, Oriza Kamuroki. He commands the effort to restore his home planet, which stands on the brink of ruin.
He is $$アマタ$$'s biological father. While visiting Vega (that is, Earth) himself in search of the $$レア・イグラー$$, he met $$アリシア$$, and $$アマタ$$ was born to them.
He had intended to leave $$アリシア$$ and $$アマタ$$ on Earth, but $$ミカゲ$$ caught wind of their existence, and $$アリシア$$ was taken to Altair.
On the battlefield he piloted Altair's strongest unit, the $$アフラ・グニス$$. His skill was overwhelming, driving Neo-DEAVA's Aquarion into desperate straits, and even overpowering $$カグラ$$ piloting the Mythical-type Aquarion.
But when $$ミカゲ$$'s scheme led to an attack on $$アリシア$$, he was shaken, and defeated when his enemies struck at that opening.
At the brink of death he reconciled with his son $$アマタ$$, and together with $$アリシア$$'s spirit, entrusted $$アマタ$$ with hope.

library.pt_360:r_d0966adc89fb0572.text:
An actress who played the heroine $$シルフィ$$ in the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' which depicts the battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and humanity 12,000 years ago.
The film itself was not well received, but the theme song she sang became a massive hit.

library.pt_360:r_e785d3d22237b192.text:
An actress who played the heroine $$シルフィ$$ in the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' which depicts the battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and humanity 12,000 years ago.
The film itself was not well received, but the theme song she sang became a massive hit.
She is $$アマタ$$'s mother. While he was still young, she crossed over to Altair together with his father $$イズモ$$, but was left in a state of suspended animation by Altair's 'Curse of Eve.'
When she awoke from that suspended state she was reunited with $$アマタ$$, and set right his long-held misunderstanding that he had been abandoned, reconciling with him. But immediately afterward she was caught up in the fighting and vanished in an explosion.

library.pt_360:r_dd7a0362a0c6b40a.text:
A legendary figure said to have saved the world, appearing in the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' which depicts the battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and humanity 12,000 years ago.
He has long red hair, a cross-shaped scar on his right cheek, and white wings on his back.

library.pt_360:r_6132bee5abbd467c.text:
The heroine of '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' a film depicting the battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and humanity 12,000 years ago.
$$ミコノ$$ was moved to tears by the singing voice of $$アリシア$$, the actress who played her.
This became the first point of connection that brought $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ together.

library.pt_360:r_2faac4cd232fe67c.text:
The heroine of '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' a film depicting the battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and humanity 12,000 years ago.
She was modeled on Sylvia, and $$ミコノ$$ was moved to tears by the singing voice of $$アリシア$$, the actress who played her.
This became the first point of connection that brought $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ together.

library.pt_360:r_e4fd15cbced63b1a.text:
A test pilot for the $$ジェニオン$$. 17 years old.
After boarding the $$ジェニオン$$ by chance encounter, he became its test pilot, both at the request of $$ＡＧ$$ of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation and for his own purposes.
He carries himself with a curt, cool air, but he is not a misanthrope and can hold his own in conversation when needed. Deep down, though, he shuts other people out, and secretly holds a resolve to throw away everything for the sake of achieving his own goal.
Before coming to $$第２新東京市$$, he worked as a $$ビーストハンター$$ (exterminating vermin that had strayed in from other parallel worlds) alongside his father, a retired soldier, and has honed field skills and survival ability to match. He also learned Jeet Kune Do from his movie-loving father.
He also has an interest in occult research as a hobby, and is a regular contributor to a certain research site online.

library.pt_360:r_defbf8e06a1d0f85.text:
A test pilot for the $$ジェニオン$$. 17 years old.
After boarding the $$ジェニオン$$ by chance encounter, he became its test pilot, both at the request of $$ＡＧ$$ of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation and for his own purposes. That purpose is to track down the mysterious being known as 'Tenshi' that appeared during the dimensional tremor that took the lives of his father and sister, with the $$ジェニオン$$ as the power to do it.
As proof of contact with Tenshi, a phenomenon called the Bloodstained Eye has developed in only one of his eyes, and he suffers from the pain and fear that come with it.
He carries himself with a curt, cool air, but he is not a misanthrope and can hold his own in conversation when needed. Deep down, though, he shuts other people out, and secretly holds a resolve to throw away everything for the sake of achieving his own goal.
Before coming to $$第２新東京市$$, he worked as a $$ビーストハンター$$ (exterminating vermin that had strayed in from other parallel worlds) alongside his father, a retired soldier, and has honed field skills and survival ability to match. He also learned Jeet Kune Do from his movie-loving father.
He also investigates various occult phenomena in order to track down 'Tenshi,' and is a regular contributor to a certain research site online.
Through his ties with friends and comrades, he grows both as a fighter and as a person. Through the Volunteer Club's activities, he even discovers the simple joy of picking up litter.
He also begins seeing $$柏葉真紀$$, a nurse he met while visiting a fellow Bloodstained Eye patient, though he keeps her in the dark about fighting in the $$ジェニオン$$.
After defeating $$ガドライト$$, who took his family from him, and destroying the Prison of Time, he resolves to keep fighting to protect what he can, in whatever way is his to give.

library.pt_360:r_a1a634a3713f37ad.text:
A student teacher assigned to Jindai High School. 21 years old.
Her subject is Modern Japanese.
She is one of the Special Student Teachers being trialed in $$第２新東京市$$, a city built around research and academia, and though still a university student, she spends a full year at her assigned school, Jindai High School.
Since the school already has several teachers with the surname Saijou, she is known simply as Ms. $$スズネ$$.
Caring and easy to get along with, she is well liked by the students, and enjoys overwhelming popularity among some of the boys in particular.
She also has an interest in occult research as a hobby, and is a regular contributor to a certain research site online.

library.pt_360:r_f7d0a8e71981d36e.text:
A student teacher assigned to Jindai High School. 21 years old.
Her subject is Modern Japanese.
She is one of the Special Student Teachers being trialed in $$第２新東京市$$, a city built around research and academia, and though still a university student, she spends a full year at her assigned school, Jindai High School.
Since the school already has several teachers with the surname Saijou, she is known simply as Ms. $$スズネ$$.
Caring and easy to get along with, she is well liked by the students, and enjoys overwhelming popularity among some of the boys in particular.
She also has an interest in occult research as a hobby, and is a regular contributor to a certain research site online.
After learning the situation her students were in, she came to understand them, and resolved to become a sub-pilot of the $$ジェニオン$$ herself in order to protect their lives as students at the same time. When aboard the $$ジェニオン$$, she handles navigation and output adjustment, and struggles alongside her students despite her inexperience.
At the same time, she serves as faculty advisor for the Volunteer Club, formed to protect their everyday lives. She goes along with the audacious scheme of treating her students' absences as extracurricular activity under her own supervision, so their time away counts as attendance.
However, stress sometimes brings out an uncharacteristically rough side of her that she normally never shows, one that can frighten those around her.
She herself was transported alone into this world by a translocation several years ago, and has no family here. Perhaps because she has spent her life absorbed in her studies, she also has no particular man she is seeing, and privately, this weighs on her mind.

library.pt_360:r_a99a0365eb625631.text:
An agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation, an enterprise group that operates across parallel worlds. Its name is short for 'AGENT.'
It fell to Earth caught up in a dimensional tremor together with the $$ジェニオン$$, and since then has overseen the $$ジェニオン$$'s field tests for the purpose of gathering data.
It also runs the dimensional shop 'D-Trader,' stocked through its own private supply routes, and personally serves as its proprietor.
A flippant sort, it shows more rich emotion than one would expect from a robot, and often stirs up trouble around it. At the same time, it is sensitive to other people's subtle feelings, and can be surprisingly caring, offering advice that cuts right to the heart of a matter.

library.pt_360:r_dc1015c6c64bedc9.text:
An agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation, an enterprise group that operates across parallel worlds. Its name is short for 'AGENT.'
It fell to Earth caught up in a dimensional tremor together with the $$ジェニオン$$, and since then has overseen the $$ジェニオン$$'s field tests for the purpose of gathering data.
It also runs the dimensional shop 'D-Trader,' stocked through its own private supply routes, and personally serves as its proprietor.
A flippant sort, it shows more rich emotion than one would expect from a robot, and often stirs up trouble around it. At the same time, it is sensitive to other people's subtle feelings, and can be surprisingly caring, offering advice that cuts right to the heart of a matter.
After the Prison of Time was destroyed, with the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ having reached a satisfactory point of completion for now, it is considering returning to $$ＤＥＭ$$.

library.pt_360:r_f67910c921357a41.text:
Commander of the Geminiss.
He can reverse the opposing emotions that sleep within human hearts, and used this power to sow chaos across the Earth $$スフィア$$.
He loves idleness and drink, and normally passes his tedious, aimless days at a bar, watching the chaos he himself unleashed upon the world. His second-in-command $$アンナロッタ$$ scolds him often for his slovenly ways, but he has not the slightest intention of changing.

library.pt_360:r_c5235fd047de722c.text:
Commander of the Geminiss.
He is the Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, and pilots $$ジェミニア$$, the strongest mobile weapon on Planet Gemini. He is also the strongest warrior among the Geminids, and like the other Geminiss he fights by channeling psychokinetic power directly into his unit's controls, though his own strength is on an entirely different level even within the Geminiss.
Using the $$スフィア$$'s power, he can reverse the opposing emotions that sleep within human hearts, and used this power to sow chaos across the Earth $$スフィア$$. His ultimate goal is to make humanity destroy itself.
He had originally been sent to Earth as a watcher over the Prison of Time, but seeing his home planet Gemini destroyed by persons unknown, he came to bitterly envy Earth's continued existence, protected as it was from $$バアル$$'s onslaught even with no future of its own. As a result, he abandoned his original duty and now moves his Geminiss subordinates toward the opposite goal: the annihilation of humanity.
He loves idleness and drink, and normally passes his tedious, aimless days at a bar, watching the chaos he himself unleashed upon the world. His second-in-command $$アンナロッタ$$ scolds him often for his slovenly ways, but he has not the slightest intention of changing. In truth, though, this was all a way of covering up the powerful anger inside him, and the resignation of having nowhere to direct it, and it was this very duality that powered the $$いがみ合う双子$$, keyed to opposing emotions.
As for his level of awakening as a $$スフィア・リアクター$$, he calls himself a Third Stage, surpassing even $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$ and $$アイム$$ Liard.
In the end, $$アドヴェント$$ threw the balance of his opposing emotions into disarray, and the $$スフィア$$ was seized from him by the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, bringing about his defeat.

library.pt_360:r_45ab29a6b52bbd32.text:
Vice-commander of the Geminiss.
A calm and capable commander, she is also a first-rate pilot of mobile weapons, boasting formidable combat ability by channeling her own psychokinetic power directly into her machine's controls.
She is utterly ruthless in carrying out her duties, and against an enemy she is capable of acts that could be called nothing short of cruel.

library.pt_360:r_1ed58a648e87f2c1.text:
Vice-commander of the Geminiss.
A calm and capable commander, she is also a first-rate pilot of mobile weapons, boasting formidable combat ability by channeling her own psychokinetic power directly into her machine's controls.
She is utterly ruthless in carrying out her duties, and against an enemy she is capable of acts that could be called nothing short of cruel.
But inwardly she struggled with conflict over what they were doing, and part of her deliberately behaved coldly just to shake off that doubt.
She is the last woman among the Geminids, the people of Planet Gemini.
She is $$ガドライト$$'s partner both publicly and privately, and carries his child.
Geminid heredity is entirely matrilineal: even when crossed with another species, as long as the mother is a Geminid, her genes are always passed on without fail. Put another way, without a woman among them, the Geminids have no way to pass their genes on to the next generation.
After $$ガドライト$$ fell, she was executed by the mysterious man $$尸空$$.

library.pt_360:r_214184008d1176d9.text:
The Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ known as the Silent Giant Crab.
He pilots the massive mobile weapon $$尸逝天$$.
He has stated himself that he belongs to Kishuku, within the mysterious organization Sidereal to which the Geminiss also once belonged, but the full extent of that organization's purpose and structure remains unknown.
A man of few words, he never shows emotion, even in battle.
He had come to Earth to execute $$アンナロッタ$$ for defying some order, but revealed himself to the people of Earth only just before the Prison of Time was destroyed.

library.pt_360:r_93f3a27ce91a4285.text:
A mysterious young man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アスクレプス$$.
He always wears a warm smile, and carries himself with a gentle, graceful bearing.
His purpose is unknown, but he faces his enemies with resolute composure, at times bordering on outright arrogance.

library.pt_360:r_d566b938fa84011c.text:
A mysterious young man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アスクレプス$$.
He is the field commander of the Chrono Reform Faction, which calls itself 'the watchers over humanity's evolution,' and serves as its de facto leader.
He always wears a warm smile, and carries himself with a gentle, graceful bearing.
The true purpose of the Chrono Reform Faction and of $$アドヴェント$$ himself remains unknown, but he faces the Geminiss, the power behind the Chrono Conservative Faction, with resolute composure, at times bordering on outright arrogance.
He calls himself 'one who is cursed,' and claims to be a man from another world in pursuit of 'Tenshi,' but in the final battle against the Geminiss, he gives his life partway through his mission in order to break $$ガドライト$$'s $$スフィア$$, the $$いがみ合う双子$$.

library.pt_360:r_093b157bdbc672c0.text:
A brigadier general of the Earth Federation Forces.
He is the leading hawk within the high command, backed by an Earth-supremacist organization that has persisted for generations.
His personality is malicious, the type to use his authority as cover for every kind of tyranny.

library.pt_360:r_b4ae18d9fb097307.text:
A brigadier general of the Earth Federation Forces.
He is the leading hawk within the high command, backed by an Earth-supremacist organization that has persisted for generations. He later became a member of the mysterious organization Chrono, which calls itself 'the watchers over humanity's evolution,' and on its orders attempted a full-scale assault on the space colonies.
His personality is malicious, the type to use his authority as cover for every kind of tyranny, and with the backing of Chrono behind him, that tendency only grew more extreme.
After the $$時空修復$$, he provoked the wrath of $$ガドライト$$, who was supposed to be his ally, and met a miserable end.

library.pt_360:r_023a5eddd8e03794.text:
Head of Scoat Lab, an anti-Dimensional-Beast consultancy.
An authority in robotics and energy engineering, she developed mobile weapons for use against Dimensional Beasts.
She is now known to the world as a leading figure in hyperspace physics.
Her first priority is always completing her own research, and she is the type to push forward at the sacrifice of everything else if need be. She has a flexible mind unbound by common sense, but seen another way, she is simply an eccentric who marches entirely to her own beat.
She was university classmates with $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr., former president of the Axion Foundation, and the two of them were always at each other's throats.
She favors traditional Japanese dress, and has the odd habit of putting on a fox mask she carries with her whenever her true nature comes to the surface.

library.pt_360:r_8ff26a922a094461.text:
Head of Scoat Lab, an anti-Dimensional-Beast consultancy.
An authority in robotics and energy engineering, she developed mobile weapons for use against Dimensional Beasts.
She is now known to the world as a leading figure in hyperspace physics.
Her first priority is always completing her own research, and she is the type to push forward at the sacrifice of everything else if need be. She has a flexible mind unbound by common sense, but seen another way, she is simply an eccentric who marches entirely to her own beat.
She was university classmates with $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr., former president of the Axion Foundation, and the two of them were always at each other's throats.
She favors traditional Japanese dress, and has the odd habit of putting on a fox mask she carries with her whenever her true nature comes to the surface.
After her memory control was undone, she made dramatic advances in her research on $$次元力$$, and worked together with a range of scientists to help bring about the $$時空修復$$.

A patient in the special ward of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital. 11 years old.
He was caught up in a dimensional tremor along with his family, and was the only one to survive. Since then he has developed the phenomenon known as the Bloodstained Eye, and appears to have lost all his emotions. The only feeling that remains is fear, and he sometimes cries out in sudden fits of terror at something unseen.

library.pt_360:r_9138ea2c68d945d6.text:
An employee in the collections department of a major moneylender.
He mainly handles collections from problem clients who have fallen behind on repayment.
His tough looks got him into this line of work, but at heart he is a warm, good-natured man with a wide network of contacts both inside and outside the company.
He shaves his head bald himself, purely for the psychological effect it has on people.

library.pt_360:r_5dc8b35d26935992.text:
A young man who committed a great sin in the past and, denied even the release of death, wanders through countless spacetimes together with Shurouga.
Hoping to escape that fate by obtaining the power of the Taiji, he pilots Shurouga into the battles of the $$スフィア$$ holders, each of whom carries a fragment of the Taiji's will.
He has already claimed four Spheres -- the Inquisitive Goat, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, and one of unknown name -- but is presently sealed away within the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars.
